property_summary: For any inputs to initialize(...) the reference contract reverts if _feeRate > 5000 so initialization only succeeds when c.feeRate() == _feeRate with _feeRate <= 5000; the mutant removes that check allowing initialization with feeRate > 5000, so there exist inputs where the mutant accepts a _feeRate > 5000 while the reference would have reverted (i.e., reference never results in c.feeRate() > 5000 but mutant can).
change_summary: Remove the feeRate upper-bound check so any _feeRate is accepted (deleting the revert on >5000).
